kpis.description_en: Skin Care CSCI sales (Compeed, ACO) - largest international category, owned brands.

kpis_story.description_fr: Lancement Opill (norgestrel) en 2024, premier contraceptif oral OTC aux US. Adoption commerciale, TAM ~$1 Md, marges premium.
kpis_story.description_en: Opill (norgestrel) launched 2024, first US OTC oral contraceptive. Commercial adoption, TAM ~$1B, premium margins.

_notes: Strong product-category disclosure across 2 segments. 2025 saw $1.3B goodwill impairment (CSCA $917M + CSCI $407M) reflecting infant formula market headwinds and lower self-care expectations.
